en.headline: Nearly 440,000 mainland arrivals over Mid-Autumn weekend
en.dek: Immigration figures show 439,532 trips by mainland visitors from Friday to Sunday, with hotels expecting occupancy above 90 per cent for the coming National Day holiday.
body: Hong Kong recorded 439,532 arrivals by mainland visitors over the three-day Mid-Autumn Festival weekend from Friday to Sunday, according to Immigration Department figures released on Monday.

The total accounted for about a quarter of the 1.73 million arrivals recorded during the period. The seven-day National Day Golden Week holiday begins on Thursday, and the department expects about 1.29 million mainland visitors to arrive, representing a 5 per cent increase in the daily average from last year.

A tourism industry representative said hotel occupancy in popular districts was expected to exceed 90 per cent during the coming holiday. Combined with the mainland’s Mid-Autumn break, some residents taking additional leave can enjoy a continuous 13-day stretch.

zh.headline: 中秋周末近44萬人次內地客訪港
zh.dek: 入境處周一公布，上周五至日錄得439,532人次內地旅客抵港，佔期間總入境約四分一；旅遊業界預料黃金周熱門區酒店入住率逾九成。
body: 入境處周一公布數字顯示，中秋連假上周五至日，本港錄得439,532人次內地旅客抵港，約佔該三日總入境1.73萬人次的四分一。
國慶七天黃金周周四開始，入境處預計期間約有129萬人次內地旅客訪港，日均較去年上升約5%。
旅遊業界代表表示，熱門地區酒店在黃金周期間的入住率料逾九成。內地中秋與國慶假期相連，部分市民若再請假，可享連續13天長假。
